name: Modern Web Guidance
works_with: Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot CLI, Google Antigravity, Grok Build, Kimi Code and agents that use the skills or GitHub CLI
short: Skills from the Chrome team that steer your coding agent toward modern browser features instead of old JavaScript patterns.
what: Modern Web Guidance is a set of skills with web platform best practices and browser compatibility data. When your agent works on web code it searches a local index and pulls in a short guide with code patterns, gotchas and fallbacks. It covers CSS layout, HTML, JavaScript APIs, performance, accessibility and the browser's built-in AI APIs, and a second pack covers Chrome extensions.
who: Web developers who use a coding agent and keep getting heavy JavaScript where a native browser feature would do. Skip it if you do not write web front ends.
needs: A coding agent that supports skills or plugins

steps.title: Install it
steps.text: This runs an interactive wizard. Add `--choose` to pick the skill packs.

steps.title: Or try it without installing
steps.code:
# Search for relevant guides
npx modern-web-guidance@latest search "animate a dialog modal backdrop"

# Retrieve a guide by ID
npx modern-web-guidance@latest retrieve "animate-to-from-top-layer"

# Scan a codebase for legacy patterns to modernize
npx modern-web-guidance@latest legacy-scan .

steps.title: Or add it as a Claude Code plugin
steps.code:
/plugin marketplace add GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance
/plugin install modern-web-guidance@googlechrome
/plugin  # Select GoogleChrome marketplace, press enter, enable AutoUpdate
/reload-plugins

steps.title: Or in Codex
steps.code:
codex plugin marketplace add GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance
codex plugin add modern-web-guidance@googlechrome

steps.title: Keep it current
steps.text: If you used the wizard, update with this. Otherwise use your agent's own plugin update.

try.label: From the README
try.text: Run `npx modern-web-guidance@latest legacy-scan .` in a web project to find legacy patterns worth modernizing.

watch: Google collects anonymous usage data: install counts, the calling agent's name, guide IDs and the search queries your agent sends to the CLI. Raw prompts are not collected. Set `DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1` in your shell profile to opt out.
Search runs offline with a local model and needs no API key.
Guides for Origin Trial and very new single-engine features stay locked until you opt in with a `.mwgrc` file or the matching CLI command.
